text:
Maya (People Ops): Uploaded handbook update: 'Whistleblower & Ethics Reporting Procedure' — highlights: anonymous intake options, retention changes, and manager response timelines. Quick review please.

Ethan (Legal): Skimmed. Key question: new retention default for reports? we moved to 7 years in the draft?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, default retention 7 years for closed investigations, reduced to 2 years for intake-only records. Added rationale and legal flags.

Rina (HR-Intl): For EMEA/APAC I added region notes — some countries require retaining identity-linked records longer for labour disputes. Included links to local counsel notes.

Sam (Hiring Ops): For rollout, prefer manager-level ack. I can export manager list and generate tokenized ack links. Two waves: Wave A = people managers + hiring managers, Wave B = all leads.

Maya (People Ops): Good. Require managers watch the 15-min briefing + complete 7-question quiz. Ack window: 10 business days. Reminder cadence: day 0, day 4, day 8. If Wave A < 60% at day 6 escalate to leadership.

Ethan (Legal): Add a short "do not investigate" checkbox for HR when intake appears meritless to capture triage decisions. Also include script for preserving confidentiality when notifying teams.

Maya (People Ops): Added the triage checkbox and a confidentiality notification snippet in the appendix.

Sam (Hiring Ops): I'll param manager_id in the ack link and webhook ack events to the People Ops tracker sheet so we don't manually update. Attaching CSV to People Ops drive before sending.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook: Whistleblower & Ethics Reporting Procedure  Manager ack due in 10d"  sending Wave A in 12 minutes.

Rina (HR-Intl): I'll record two briefings for EMEA-friendly times and include subtitles in FR/DE/ES.

Maya (People Ops): Final action items: Rina upload localized recordings by EOD Thur, Sam run exports + schedule reminders this afternoon, Ethan review the confidentiality script for legal signoff. I'll publish company note once Wave A hits 65% ack.

Ethan (Legal): Will review confidentiality script and DM any edits by EOD.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all :thumbsup:
